correctness.rationale: Exact zero-rank intervals \([a-s,a]\) for marker placements, covering inequality \(K(s+1)\ge n\), and zero-run inequality \(Z\le2(K+1)\) prove the lower bound for every \(n\ge4\). Equality is exhausted by \(s=1\), plus \(s=2\) at odd lengths. The endpoint-rank analysis forces the unique even optimizer and the \(m+3\) odd forms; all satisfy the original constraints. A direct exhaustive short-length checker enumerated 1,640,493 hosts over lengths four through fourteen and matched the complete optimizer sets, CHECK_OK. Finite verification corroborates only; analytic case analysis covers all lengths. No independent review.

value.rationale: A full one-hot family represents all possible positions of a single marker in a length-n reference, a canonical sparse source family for synchronized subsequence synthesis. Imposing a contiguous zero-homopolymer cap on the host creates a nontrivial exact all-length optimum and rigidity theorem: one even-length optimum, m+3 odd-length optima, and spontaneous symmetric cap avoidance by all optima. It is a complete natural structural classification, not an arbitrary fixed-size table or reparameterization; multi-marker generalization is unproved.
